title: 24th Sitting of third session of 2025

items.text: Opening recitation (Hamd and Salawat); the sitting begins.
Roll call of members present at the sitting.
Announcement of the day's agenda (Agenda No. އޖ/24/3/2025).
Debate continues on the Budget Committee's report on the proposed State Budget for 2026.
Report of the Committee of the Whole House on the bill to amend the Constitution of the Republic of Maldives.
Voting on items from the day's business that have reached the voting stage.

summary: The sitting continued debating the Budget Committee's report on the 2026 State Budget and took up the Committee of the Whole House's report on the constitutional amendment bill.
